faqs: What is free, and what needs Pro?

Opening, browsing, previewing and extracting supported archives are free, including encrypted archives, multi-volume archives, partial extraction and ZIP filename encoding tools. Unwrap Pro is a one-time purchase for creating ZIP, 7z and tar.gz archives, ZIP encryption, presets and media packing.
How do I open or extract an archive?

Open Unwrap and choose the archive-opening action on the home screen, then select a file through Files. Browse the contents and choose all or selected items to extract. Pick a destination folder when asked. You can also share a file to Unwrap from another app; after import completes, open Unwrap to continue.

Some ZIP files use a filename encoding from another language or operating system. Open the filename encoding control in the archive browser, try the appropriate encoding, and check the preview. Common choices include GBK or GB18030 for simplified Chinese, Big5 for traditional Chinese, and Shift-JIS for Japanese. Encoding changes cannot repair names that were already corrupted when the archive was created.
Why won't an archive open or extract?

Make sure the download has finished and the file provider has made the archive available locally. Check that you have enough free storage for both temporary work and the extracted result. For encrypted files, confirm the password. For multi-volume archives, make every part available together and open the first part. A listed format may still contain an unsupported compression method, or the archive may be damaged.

Extracted files go to the destination you choose through Files. Archives you create can be saved in the Unwrap folder or another chosen location. The Unwrap folder appears in Files and belongs to the app: deleting Unwrap also deletes that folder. Move anything you want to keep elsewhere before uninstalling.
How do I restore Unwrap Pro?

Use the Apple Account that made the purchase. Open Settings in Unwrap, open Unwrap Pro, and choose Restore Purchase if Pro is not unlocked. An internet connection may be needed to check the purchase. If it still isn't available, contact us with the app version, device model and a description of the issue. Never send your Apple Account password.
Can Unwrap create password-protected 7z or RAR files?

Unwrap creates ZIP, 7z and tar.gz archives. Password protection when creating an archive is available for ZIP, using AES-256 or the older ZipCrypto compatibility mode. Unwrap can read supported RAR archives but does not create RAR files.

Archive processing happens locally on your device. Unwrap does not send your archive contents to our servers. If you choose iCloud Drive or another file provider, that service handles the storage and transfer under its own settings and privacy policy.
support.details_body: Include your device model, iOS or iPadOS version, Unwrap version, archive format, and the steps that led to the issue. A redacted screenshot can help. privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Unwrap
privacy.description: How Unwrap handles files, local preferences, App Store purchases, support emails and visits to this GitHub Pages website.
privacy.heading:
Your files.
Your business.
privacy.intro: Unwrap processes your archives on your device. We don't operate an archive-upload service, and the app has no advertising or analytics SDK.
sections: This policy covers the Unwrap iPhone and iPad app and this product website. For privacy questions or requests, contact the Unwrap developer at boxing.support@gmail.com.

Opening, previewing, compressing and extracting archives happen on your device. Unwrap does not send archive contents or archive passwords to the developer. Files are accessed when you select them, share them to Unwrap, or grant access through system interfaces. Previewing, importing and archive operations can create temporary working files on the device.

Unwrap stores app settings and information needed for its features locally, such as language and appearance preferences, recent archive references, folder access bookmarks, filename encoding choices and purchase entitlement state. The app and its share extension use a shared app container to transfer selected files and preferences. These records are not sent to the developer. Archives saved in the app's Unwrap folder are visible in Files. Deleting the app deletes its app-owned storage, including that folder; move files you wish to keep to another location first.

If you choose iCloud Drive, a network location or a third-party file provider, that provider handles the associated storage and transfer according to its own settings and privacy policy. Apple's photo picker supplies the photos or videos you select. Notifications, if you allow them, are used for local operation status. You can manage permissions in system Settings. Device backups and operating-system diagnostics are controlled by your Apple settings and Apple's services.

Unwrap Pro is purchased through Apple's App Store. Apple handles payment details. Unwrap uses StoreKit transaction and entitlement information to unlock Pro and restore purchases. The developer does not receive your payment card details through the app. Apple's purchase and privacy terms apply to its processing.

If you email support, we receive the address you write from and the content and attachments you choose to send. We use that information to respond to your request and investigate the reported issue. Email is handled by our email service provider. Please avoid sending passwords, private archives, or other unnecessary personal information. We keep correspondence only as needed to handle support, resolve related issues and meet applicable obligations. You can ask us to delete your support correspondence; some information may need to be retained where required by law.

This website has no analytics scripts, advertising, tracking cookies, third-party fonts, or embedded social widgets. It is hosted by GitHub Pages. GitHub logs visitors' IP addresses for security purposes and may process service data under the GitHub Privacy Statement. This hosting activity is separate from the Unwrap app's local archive processing. Following an external link is subject to the destination service's privacy policy.

You can remove files through Files, clear available temporary storage from Unwrap Settings, manage system permissions, or delete the app. Files stored outside the app's own storage, including files at a cloud provider, must be managed at those locations. Contact us to ask about or request deletion of information you voluntarily sent to support.
We may update this policy when the app, website or relevant practices change. The latest version is published on this page with its update date.
